run_audio_diffusion_pipeline: run the AudioDiffusionPipeline to generate audio samples from noise using DDIM or DDPM scheduler
run_audio_diffusion_with_masking: run the AudioDiffusionPipeline with raw audio input and mask start and end seconds for inpainting
encode_images_to_noise: encode a list of PIL images into a noise tensor using the reverse denoising process
interpolate_tensors_with_slerp: interpolate between two tensors using spherical linear interpolation with a given alpha value
get_default_steps: get the default number of denoising steps based on whether the scheduler is DDIM or DDPM
